parameters.atmosphere: evacuated and filled with argon gas

evidence.quote: High-entropy alloy ingots of Cu 1.2 NiMnFe 0.5 Cr 0.5 Al 0.2 (at.%) were prepared by induction melting of commercial purity metals ( > 99%) and casting into a cylindrical steel mold ( Φ 35 × 275 mm). To minimize elemental loss, the furnace chamber was evacuated and filled with argon gas.
The as-cast ingots were heat-treated at 950 ◦ C for 24 h to enhance chemical homogeneity.
